abstract: This project aims to develop a fitness information management system web application.. By developing according to the existing fitness center management system with the help of technologies such as PHP, MySQL with observation evidence. Which all tasks in the system can be done through a web browser. There are three main users for this system. Firstly, members. Members can search for class schedules, both personal trainer and fitness instructor schedules and can apply for a course.Secondly,trainers. Trainers can edit their personal information and check their own schedules,and accept member's appointments. Lastly, the administrator. The administrator can manage user information,check the payment information, report member's payment,check daily income,collect bad debts,office management,member services,check trainer information,trainer salary information report. The end results of the project showed that the system reduces the time of work, makes the service faster, helps to solve problems, process error work to facilitate the issuance of a summary report.

abstract: With the new industrial revolution looming over our generation, the rise of emerging technology is a common occurrence in our age. These many fascinating innovations may seem that they are still early in their development cycle yet their potential to reach the heights to impact history is always present. One of these is Web 3.0, a group of technologies that once combined, contributes to the third generation of the internet. The main constituents are blockchain where it acts as a digital ledger, smart contracts that are programmable to provide functionality, and cryptocurrencies where it provides value towards this technology. We take all these properties into consideration when we are building our Web 3.0 decentralized application.

abstract: The Air Quality Measuring Station is a tool created to keep track of numerous environmental factors that have an impact on a certain area's air quality. It has sensors that can monitor the amount of carbon monoxide (CO), humidity, temperature, and particulate matter with sizes of 2.5 and 10 micrometers (PM2.5 and PM10). These factors are crucial in determining a location's air quality and any potential health dangers for people. The station delivers real-time data that can be accessed remotely and makes reliable measurements of these parameters. Policymakers, health professionals, and the general public can utilize the gathered data to guide their decisions about how to lessen air pollution and enhance overall air quality.
